result.title: Code-Interactive Visual Reasoning for Financial Candlestick Understanding
result.summary: Financial candlestick understanding requires locating visual elements, aligning them across trading dates and panels, and combining observations through numerical and financial reasoning. Answer accuracy alone does not reveal whether predictions are supported by chart evidence. We introduce Code-Interactive Financial Candlestick Reasoning and present Fin-Thinker, a model based on Qwen3.5-9B that generates and executes code to acquire evidence and perform computations. The model uses the returned observations to guide subsequent reasoning. To train these capabilities, we construct FinKLine-32K with 32,184 replay-verified code-observation trajectories collected through teacher-guided student exploration. These include successful solutions with and without error recovery. Our three-stage training framework combines foundational visual-code fine-tuning, financial process supervision of successful reasoning and corrective continuations, and execution-feedback reinforcement learning. For evaluation, we introduce FinKLineBench with 1,200 questions across 138 financial task types to assess answer correctness, code execution, and evidence grounding separately. On FinKLineBench, Fin-Thinker improves strict accuracy by 13.1 and 33.2 percentage points over the best-performing direct-answer baseline among those evaluated and its base model with sandbox access, respectively. Training-stage ablations further show that financial process supervision and execution-feedback reinforcement learning yield successive improvements in both answer accuracy and GPT-5.6-judged grounded accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 针对金融 K 线图理解，提出 Fin-Thinker：模型生成并执行代码定位视觉元素、对齐多面板并完成数值计算，再用返回观测引导后续推理；配套构建 32K 可重放校验的代码—观测轨迹，采用视觉代码微调、金融过程监督与执行反馈强化学习三阶段训练，并发布按答案正确性、代码执行与证据接地分别评测的基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文关注视觉证据获取、证据接地与「答案正确但无证据支撑」的诊断，并把证据接地与答案正确性分开评测，对 LVR 的「LOOK/证据筛选」与轨迹监督、贡献分配问题有可比线索；但推理状态属显式代码与外部观测，而非内部 latent，需核查其接地指标与过程监督设计能否迁移。
